question: If a sum of money becomes (41)/(40) of itself in (1)/(4) year at a particular rate of simple interest, then the annual rate of interest is :
solution:
**Given:**

If a sum of money becomes (41)/(40) of itself in (1)/(4) year at a particular rate of simple interest.

**Formula used:**

SI(Simple Interest) = Amount(A) - Principle(P)

SI = P × R × T/100 , where R is the Rate of interest, T is the Time taken 

**Calculations:**

Let P = x Rs 

⇒ A = 41/40 × x Rs

T = 1/4 years

⇒ SI = 41/40 × x - x = x/40

Now, 

SI = P × R × T/100

⇒ R = SI × 100/ P × T 

⇒ R = x/40 × 100/ x × 1/4

⇒ R = 10%

**∴ The annual rate of interest = 10%**
